etym.s: [स्तु 2. STU, drop, be clotted: in stuka, 🞄stúkā, and stoká]

spans.s: stú-kā, f. tuft or hair, lock of wool, 🞄curly hair on a bullʼs forehead (V.): -vín, 🞄a. shaggy (RV.¹).

stu-tá, pp. √ stu;
 n. praise: -śastrá, 🞄n. du. Stotra and Śastra.

stu-tya, fp. to be praised, praiseworthy;
 🞄-tva, n. praiseworthiness.
